method: Deterministic stratified sample: one likely self-serve app and one likely constrained app from each of the 10 categories. Four fields were checked against first-party documentation: auth, credential access, API surface and buildability blocker.

checks.note: Private tokens and OAuth are both self-serve; broad CRM APIs.

API is broad; business verification and template review remain real gates.
OAuth and API-key flows are public and developer accessible.

Partner account, dev stores and GraphQL Admin API support a toolkit now.

Self-serve token, broad Actor and dataset APIs, plus official MCP.

REST, GraphQL and GitHub App auth are public and comprehensive.
